claim_boundaries.allowed_interpretation: The experiments provide evidence that the tested LTLC shift formulations did not yield robust long-tail recognition gains under the locked validation protocol. The temperature component showed calibration improvements on validation, but this constitutes calibration evidence rather than recognition evidence.

original_ltlc.interpretation: The original rarity-adaptive shift did not produce a selected recognition improvement. The samplewise temperature component produced validation calibration improvements, particularly NLL, but calibration alone cannot establish long-tail recognition because positive scalar temperature preserves hard predictions.

required_disclosures.best_val_aa_checkpoint_recovery: Five missing best-validation-AA CE checkpoints were recovered by exact historical retraining before official test inspection.
required_disclosures.cell21a_correction: An intermediate R1 recognition result was superseded after detecting an unfair comparator mismatch; the corrected comparison used seed-42-frozen Standard-LA parameters.
required_disclosures.official_test: No Notebook 05 development decision used the official test set.
required_disclosures.original_ltlc_result: Original LTLC selected alpha=0 in all corrected runs and failed the recognition side of the development gate.
required_disclosures.r1_result: R1 selected beta=0 for all datasets and failed the corrected frozen-baseline recognition robustness gate.
required_disclosures.r1_revision: R1 was a validation-driven protocol revision that decoupled the adaptive coefficient from tau and was frozen before R1 evaluation.
required_disclosures.tangdaowan_saturation_amendment: The original Tangdaowan-only development gate was found to be classification-saturated, motivating an additional validation-only diagnostic on Pingan and Qingyun.

revision_R1.interpretation: After correcting the robustness comparator, R1 is exactly identical to the seed-42-frozen Standard-LA reference on all datasets and seeds because seed 42 selected tau=0 and beta=0 for every dataset. R1 therefore provides no recognition evidence.

superseded_intermediate_result.reason: The original Cell 21A robustness comparison used per-seed-selected Standard-LA tau values while R1 used seed-42-frozen parameters. This caused the apparent Qingyun robustness signal. The result is superseded by the fair frozen-baseline comparator correction.
